articles.title: Lockheed Martin to expand production in India, if it wins transport aircraft bid
articles.summary: Lockheed Martin aims to significantly expand its production capabilities in India if it secures the crucial bid to supply medium transport aircraft to the Indian armed forces. This move by the US aerospace giant would bolster India's indigenous defence manufacturing ecosystem, align with 'Make in India' initiatives, and deepen strategic bilateral partnership, as indicated by a senior official.

articles.title: Accepted her as she was still PM: Indian envoy on Hasina's flight
articles.summary: A new report details former President Trump's alleged 'red-carpet surrender' to China during a White House visit, raising questions about US-China relations. Separately, speculation is emerging regarding Jeff Bezos potentially running for US President, with Lauren Sanchez envisioned as First Lady, signaling a possible high-profile entry into national politics.

articles.title: Health minister urges public cooperation with health workers to curb infectious diseases
articles.summary: The provided text snippets highlight two distinct national news events. Former MP CM Shivraj Singh Chouhan criticized the Congress party for labeling PM Modi "illegal," citing it as an example of their frustration. Separately, a horrific crime was reported in Chhattisgarh, where a Class 9 girl was abducted, drugged, and gang-raped in Mungeli. These events underscore current political discourse and significant social challenges within India.
